purpose: Teach: じゅん/素子/すぅ/稔/ヤマト/松子/春日/立花

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがお友達のじゅんさんを夕食に招待されたわ
lines.en: Sho, your father has invited your friend Jun over for dinner tonight.
lines.style: Warm, matter-of-fact delivery. Light cadence — informative but unhurried. Gentle opening, like she's sharing something she thinks he'll like to know.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんと素子おばさんの家に行ったよ
lines.en: Mom, I went to Dad's friend Motoko's house.
lines.style: Small, proud voice. Slightly faster than normal — eager to share. Bright forward momentum without being loud. The pleasure of having done something worth mentioning.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが眠そうに「すぅ」と寝息を立ててらしたわ
lines.en: Sho, your father was sleeping so deeply he was making little snoring sounds.
lines.style: Dry, affectionate amusement underneath. Wry half-smile in the voice. Slow, deliberate pacing on the description. No mockery — just the tender observation of someone she loves being very, very tired.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんのお友達の稔おじさんに会ったよ
lines.en: Mom, I met Dad's friend Minoru.
lines.style: Bright, direct. Quick delivery with genuine interest. Simple and factual but animated — he's pleased with his own memory and wants to make sure she hears it.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがヤマト運輸の集荷を待ってらっしゃるわ
lines.en: Sho, your father is waiting for the Yamato delivery to arrive.
lines.style: Steady, observational tone. Unhurried. Matter-of-fact but not dismissive — she's noting something she's noticed about him. Quiet acceptance in the pace.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、お父さんが「松子さんのおはぎは絶品」って仰ってたよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad said that Matsuko's ohagi are absolutely delicious.
lines.style: Eager, straightforward. Bounces slightly on the praise — he's repeating something he heard and found important. Natural, boyish energy. Wants her to know what Dad thinks.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんと春日大社にお参りに行かれるそうよ
lines.en: Sho, your father is going to visit Kasuga Shrine to pray.
lines.style: Calm, reflective delivery. Slower pace. The quietness of something meaningful being shared without fanfare. Gentle finality — she's telling him something that matters.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんと立花の生け花展に行ったよ
lines.en: Mom, I went with Dad to the Tachibana ikebana exhibition.
lines.style: Warm satisfaction in a small voice. Proud closure — he's saved the best for last. Slight lift at the end, like he knows this is worth her attention. Genuine pleasure, not performance.
